title: Google Maps Business Extractor Input
description: Configure search query, target location, and extraction parameters for Google Maps business listings.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Category or keyword to search for on Google Maps (e.g. 'dental clinic', 'restaurants', 'gym').

location.title: Location
location.description: City, locality, area, or landmark (e.g. 'Dharampeth, Nagpur', 'New York, NY').

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of listings to extract. Leave empty or set to null to collect all available listings in the feed.

min_rating.title: Minimum Rating
min_rating.description: Filter listings to only include businesses with at least this star rating (e.g. 4.0).

enrich_details.title: Enrich Full Details
enrich_details.description: When enabled, visits each business page to extract phone numbers, website URLs, and full opening hours. Uncheck for ultra-fast list-level extraction.

auto_areas.title: Auto-Discover City Areas
auto_areas.description: Automatically discover and sweep all localities across the city via OpenStreetMap to achieve complete city-wide coverage beyond Google's 120-listing feed limit.

max_areas.title: Max Areas to Sweep
max_areas.description: Maximum number of auto-discovered city localities to sweep in one run.

extra_locations.title: Additional Locations
extra_locations.description: List of additional areas or localities to scrape and merge in this run.

extra_queries.title: Additional Query Keywords
extra_queries.description: List of additional query keyword variations to sweep and merge.

export_excel.title: Save Formatted Excel File
export_excel.description: Generate a professionally styled multi-sheet Excel file (.xlsx) and save it to the Apify Key-Value Store as 'OUTPUT.xlsx'.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Optional: Enable if you have Apify Residential Proxies or custom proxies. Leave disabled for standard direct connection.

use_playwright_source.title: Use Live Playwright Scraper
use_playwright_source.description: True to run live Google Maps scraping via Playwright Chromium. Set to false for synthetic demo testing.
